items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I got a letter from Eddie Edwards the other day. [INTERVIEWEE] The trombone man?

ctx.x: He was tired anyhow. Well, that saved the day. They all went wild as to what we could do. And then Loyal Canna, of course, he played a little trombone with his, took his shoes off and played slide with his feet, which was nothing. But I mean he could do it very easily. But they ate it up. And so they kept us the hour and let the other boys go home. But that was the only reason the way we saved face was by doing a little stunt other than just playing music. Now, we definitely had the best orchestra. Those boys…
I got a letter from Eddie Edwards the other day.
